alt: The review dialog of a project tape shows its path, its trust status, the session and panes it builds, and the whole file. After Run once, TUIOS builds the session notes with the panes code, serve and watch.
bashrc:
PS1='\[\e[35m\]\W\[\e[0m\] \[\e[34m\]>\[\e[0m\] '
export LS_COLORS='di=34:ln=36:ex=32'
alias ls='ls --color=auto'
# OSC 7: tell tuios the working folder, so it finds the project tape.
PROMPT_COMMAND+=('printf "\e]7;file://%s%s\e\\" "$HOSTNAME" "$PWD"')
